article.title: ‘East of Eden’ review: A sprawling and relevant critique of American values

article.content: The series begins and ends with two wars, the Civil War and World War I, with the Native American genocide in the middle of these. The post ‘East of Eden’ review: A sprawling and relevant critique of American values appeared first on MR Online .
